$comment: Two-level phase grouping over the 12 StageKinds. Static entry_approval remains risk/compatibility metadata; routine runtime confirmation belongs to Scoping, and post-Scoping crossings auto-advance after typed target/Candidate barriers and deterministic Gates. The exact double-V2Only Candidate flow ignores generic phase/static exploit approval and recognizes only exact Candidate plan approval plus durable review resume. The vuln phase completes only after Verification exact DB truth and durable consolidation; V2 deliverable prose, spawned candidates, and process-local chain-wave state cannot complete it. opened_next_wave is a durable runtime cursor override with no static back-edge in operation_graph.json; closed_no_delta and exhausted take the normal DAG, with exhausted carrying reportable residual risk.
